The Giants agreed to terms on a 2027 contract with Camilo Doval (who will reportedly earn $6.3 million) and tendered contracts LHP Sam Hentges, RHP Randy Rodriguez and INF Casey Schmitt. RHP Rowan Wick and OF Victor Bericoto were non-tendered.

The Giants added LHP Henry Lalane, RHP Marty Gair and RHP Josh Bostick to their 40-man roster to protect them from the Rule 5 Draft. INF Christian Koss and RHP Rowan Wick were DFA'd, leaving the Giants with 40 players on their 40-man roster.
The Giants’ 40-man roster shuffling has begun. Jason Foley, Matt Gage and Osleivis Basabe were outrighted to Triple-A Sacramento, and Grant McCray and Braxton Roxby were claimed off waivers.

threads.subject: San Francisco Giants staff and front office

reports.text: The Giants have officially named James Rowson their new offensive coordinator. Rowson spent the last three seasons as the Yankees' lead hitting coach.

The Giants are promoting quality control coach Taira Uematsu to first base coach. He’s the first Japanese born and raised base coach in MLB history. Shane Robinson will move to a minor league role for family reasons.

Buster Posey met with media at GM meetings and said he doubted the Giants will sign any free agents with qualifying offers. Reading between the lines, they are looking at next year as a build-up season.

Nationals have acquired LHP Reiver Sanmartin from the Giants for RHP Robert Cranz. Sanmartin, 30, had 4.22 ERA, 1.359 WHIP in 24 games this season, was DFA'd earlier this week. Cranz, 7th round pick in '24, had strong year with Wilmington and Harrisburg, struggled at Rochester.
The Giants DFA’d Reiver Sanmartin and declined Rowan Wick’s club option. They now have 40 players on their 40-man roster.
The #reds have claimed off waivers RHP Duncan Davitt from the Giants and RHP Paxton Shultz from the Nationals.

Parker and Tena are probably the most-notable moves here. Parker was going to arbitration-eligible after having TJ surgery in July. Tena was out of options and less defensive value than the just-acquired Nate Furman.

If you were busy watching a different sport last night, the Nationals traded for Giants infielder Nate Furman and DFA’d Richard Lovelady. There will be more moves today as they pare down their 40-man roster, kicking off what could be an eventful November. natsjournal.com/p/offseason-...

The Nationals announce they've acquired 2B/3B Nat Furman from the Giants for minor-league LHP Tony Neubeck. Furman, 25, played in 22 MLB games this season, going 4-for-32. Lefty hitter slashed .292/.377/.414 at AAA. Has 2 more option years. LHP Richard Lovelady was DFA'd to clear a 40-man spot.
